parameters.command: BASE_DIR=`ls -td /backups/base/hrm_base_* 2>/dev/null | head -1` && if [ -z "$BASE_DIR" ]; then echo "BASE_RESTORE_FAILED:Khong_tim_thay_thu_muc_backup"; exit 1; fi && echo "Restoring Physical from: $BASE_DIR" && docker stop hrm-database && docker run --rm --volumes-from hrm-database alpine sh -c "rm -rf /var/lib/postgresql/data/* && tar -xzf ${BASE_DIR}/base.tar.gz -C /var/lib/postgresql/data/ && if [ -f ${BASE_DIR}/pg_wal.tar.gz ]; then mkdir -p /var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_wal && tar -xzf ${BASE_DIR}/pg_wal.tar.gz -C /var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_wal/; fi && touch /var/lib/postgresql/data/recovery.signal && chown -R 999:999 /var/lib/postgresql/data && chmod 700 /var/lib/postgresql/data" && docker start hrm-database && sleep 5 && docker exec hrm-database pg_isready -U postgres && echo "BASE_RESTORE_SUCCESS:$BASE_DIR" || echo "BASE_RESTORE_FAILED"
